questions.stem: Which of the following correctly completes this sentence? During the night I ___ an unusual noise in the attic.
Which word correctly completes the sentence? Tina’s writing was [dropdown] today than yesterday.
Click on the highlighted word or words that 'he' refers to in this sentence. Michael and his friend Percy were to meet Mr Grey but he failed to arrive.
Drag one word to correctly complete the sentence. “Read the instructions ___ you make a mistake!” warned Dad.
In which sentence is the comma (",") used correctly?
options: Looking, over her shoulder Josie realised she was not being followed at all.
Looking over her shoulder Josie realised she was not being followed, at all.
Looking over her shoulder, Josie realised she was not being followed at all.
Looking over her shoulder Josie realised, she was not being followed at all.
questions.selected_answer: Looking over her shoulder, Josie realised she was not being followed at all.

questions.stem: In which sentence does the punctuation show that Mum was not amused?
options: Mum said, “You bought a new phone?”
Mum said, “You bought a new phone!”
Mum said, “You bought a new phone.”
Mum said, “You bought a new phone . . . ”
questions.selected_answer: Mum said, “You bought a new phone!”

questions.stem: Which two options correctly complete the sentence? One of the best people ___ is the local builder.
Which word correctly completes the sentence? George is a diligent student and he always does ___ best.

Order the events in this text. Put the event that happened first at the top. Before he walked the dog, Jon had breakfast and then his mother made him tidy his room. Surprisingly, he found the comic he’d bought a month ago. (drag into slots 1-4)
questions.selected_answer: Jon bought a comic. > Jon ate breakfast. > Jon cleaned his room. > Jon walked the dog.
